report.executive_summary: The shift produced 970 units of Product‑X against a target of 1000 (Minor Deviation). Downtime was 20 min with a loss of 30 units. A high‑vibration warning alarm on pump P‑101 was active during the shift; the operator noted the equipment was operating normally.
evidence_limitations: Vibration threshold values are not provided, limiting assessment of the alarm severity.
No maintenance record exists for the vibration issue during this shift.
